turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the firewood pile at least 30 feet from the house, or cover it fully with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The homeowner says the firewood pile sits against the wall and is covered with a tarp at night.

findings.instruction: Replace the 5 feet of cedar fence touching the house with metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: The homeowner says the fence is old cedar that was there when they bought the place.

findings.instruction: Haul the cut brush off the yard or bag it for the green waste bin.
findings.reason: The homeowner says the brush was cut last weekend and has not been hauled away yet.
